A_code_safety.reason: Effects default off; shadow cannot execute; enforcement requires promotion approval and exactly one effect; bear/ATR/ADX/exact mapping tests pass.

B_contract_readiness.reason: Canonical snapshot, legacy mapping, config resolver/hash, shadow-safe config degradation, immutable entry snapshot and separated world state are implemented.

C_evidence_readiness.reason: New lineage code is complete, but rebuilt legacy evidence has 100% missing detector confidence and is not native post-remediation evidence.

D_research_readiness.reason: Feature leakage, backtest units/policies and walk-forward tuner are remediated; eligible timestamped holdout evidence is insufficient.

E_shadow_readiness.reason: No control/shadow parity window, sufficient native outcomes or approved promotion artifact exists.

F_production_enforcement.reason: Risk-reduction rollout, rollback drill and separate approvals for decision, sizing and TP/SL have not occurred.

required_next_evidence: Collect native post-remediation prediction, decision, entry and outcome lineage.
Run non-executing control/shadow parity window on identical cutoffs.
Produce timestamp-complete holdout metrics with transaction cost and slippage assumptions.
Approve risk-reduction-only rollout and verify rollback before any risk-increasing effect.
